subject: QuillBridge integration: LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter + tracing workshop
messages:
From: Eva Torres <eva@quillbridge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@quillbridge.ai>, Lucy Kim <lucy@promptsmith.consulting>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + proposed scope for Redwood adapter work

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our product team loved the latency profile on the dedicated runtime. As discussed, QuillBridge would like to scope a joint deliverable: a LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter that includes lightweight tracing hooks compatible with Redwood's tracer spec, and a prompt-tooling extension so our customers can push prompt templates directly to Redwood Optimize.

High level asks: 
- A runbook for tracing events (span names, token-attribution metadata) so our telemetry shows up in Redwood Console.
- A thin adapter that maps QuillBridge client calls to Redwood model variants (hosted vs dedicated) with graceful fallback.
- A short workshop (2-3 hrs) to align engineers and validate end-to-end instrumentation.

I've attached a short proposal + a draft workshop agenda. We're flexible on timing next week. Can you loop in the best eng contact on your side for the technical workshop?

Cheers,
Eva Torres
Head of Integrations | QuillBridge, Inc.
attachments: quillbridge-integration-proposal.pdf, workshop-agenda.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Eva Torres <eva@quillbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed scope for Redwood adapter work

Eva — great to meet virtually. Thanks for the clear scope. We're excited to collaborate. Quick answers inline: 

- Tracing runbook: Jonas will author the mapping (span names + token attributes) and share a draft prior to the workshop.
- Adapter: Our SDK team can prototype a shim that supports both LangChain Agent calls and LlamaIndex insert/query flows; we'll include connector tests against both hosted and dedicated variants.
- Workshop: Proposed slots: Tue 12/15 or Thu 12/17 (PST). 2-hour hands-on lab + 30-min follow-up.

Jonas — can you take point on the tracer mapping? Vanessa — I'll add you to the agenda to cover deployment/fallback policy.

Marissa
VP, Ecosystem | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Eva Torres <eva@quillbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed scope for Redwood adapter work

Marissa / Eva — happy to take point. A few quick technical clarifications before I draft the tracing runbook: 

1) Which LangChain versions are we targeting for the adapter? QuillBridge: v0.0.37+? 
2) For LlamaIndex, do you prefer event-level token attribution or per-response summary attribution for the initial pass? Token-level adds complexity but gives better observability for model rollouts.
3) Do you want the adapter to emit spans directly to Redwood's ingestion endpoint, or do you prefer local export (OTLP) with a sidecar?

If you can confirm (1)-(3) I'll put together a 1-pager and sample span mapping by end of day Monday. Also cc'ing Grace so she can propose a minimal test harness for the adapter.

— Jonas
Senior Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@quillbridge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Eva Torres <eva@quillbridge.ai>, Lucy Kim <lucy@promptsmith.consulting>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed scope for Redwood adapter work

Jonas — quick replies: 
1) LangChain: We will target 0.0.40 and keep compatibility shims for 0.0.36+. Our client libs are pinned in our repo; I'll share a small matrix.
2) LlamaIndex: Let's start with per-response attribution for the workshop (lower risk), but we want token-level in the roadmap.
3) Spans: Sending OTLP to a local sidecar is our preference for now (customers often run exporters). But we want the adapter to optionally flip to Redwood ingestion when running on QuillBridge-managed deployments.

Attached: a short matrix of LangChain/LlamaIndex versions and a proposed day-1 test scenario.

Samir
Senior Platform Engineer | QuillBridge
attachments: version-matrix.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Eva Torres <eva@quillbridge.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@quillbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Lucy Kim <lucy@promptsmith.consulting>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed scope for Redwood adapter work

All — thanks for the clarifications. Summary and next steps: 

- Tech targets: LangChain 0.0.40 (+compat for 0.0.36+), LlamaIndex day-1 per-response attribution. Jonas will draft the tracing runbook and sample span mapping by Mon 12/14.
- Workshop: Tue 12/15 10:00–12:30 PST. Agenda: 10:00 kickoff + architecture, 10:30 hands-on adapter wiring, 11:45 test-harness run, 12:15 action items. Vanessa will cover deployment fallback policy and cost/throughput considerations.
- Deliverables (by EOW 12/19): prototype shim in our sandbox, tracing runbook, integration test checklist.

Links: workshop agenda and proposal here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QbBridge-Integration-Docs
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/QB-2026-328

Eva — once you confirm participants for 12/15 we'll send calendar invites and pre-reads. Looking forward to it.

Best,
